name: Postat' holosu
source:
'Believe in yourself!', 'Follow your heart!', 'Trust your intuition!'... The whole modern world is forever talking about 'self-discovery', 'self-realization' and 'self-' whatever. But for some reason no one explains how to find the same ephemeral and elusive 'self', which seems to be the answer to all life's questions, the very last piece of the puzzle. Is it a journey that everyone has to take, called,on their own?

Nina, a not-quite-new student of AMiOK (Olga Kobylyanska Academy of Arts), will have to find out about this. Nina has a completely normal life. She loves someone, fears something, and wants something. But above all, she wants to find herself. This is exactly what her new work for the art exhibition of the academy is about: 'Puzzle Lady'.

At this exhibition, a crime occurs that will set off a chain of events that will lead to inevitable changes in Nina's life and her relationship with her identity.

[Translated from [url=https://mahousparkle.itch.io/voices-figure]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“相信自己！”、“跟随你的心！”、“相信你的直觉！”……整个现代世界永远在谈论“自我发现”、“自我实现”和“自我”等等。但由于某种原因，没有人解释如何找到同样短暂且难以捉摸的“自我”，这似乎是所有生命问题的答案，是拼图的最后一块。这是每个人都必须独自踏上的旅程吗？

尼娜（Nina）是AMiOK（奥尔加·科比良斯卡艺术学院）的一名不太新的学生，她必须找出这一点。尼娜过着完全正常的生活。她爱一个人，害怕一些东西，想要一些东西。但最重要的是，她想找到自己。这正是她为学院艺术展创作的新作品：《拼图女士》。

在这次展览中，发生了一起犯罪事件，这将引发一系列事件，从而导致尼娜的生活以及她与自己的身份的关系发生不可避免的变化。

[译自[url=https://mahousparkle.itch.io/voices-figure]itch.io[/url]]
